auftrag: Three people tell Agent Wren what they did on Monday. Listen carefully. Then solve four puzzles.

saetze: On Monday I left the Academy at six thirty.
At eight I came back for my glasses.
In the corridor I saw Mr Hale.
On Monday I closed the café at nine.
At ten a man in gloves came in.
He left a parcel in the locker.
On Monday I went home at six.
I ate dinner and watched TV.
I never came back to the Academy.

raetsel.frage: Who says what? Put each sentence with the right person.

aussagen.text: I came back for my glasses.
I closed the café at nine.
A man in gloves came to my café.
I never came back to the Academy.
I ate dinner and watched TV.
I saw Mr Hale in the corridor.

raetsel.hilfe1: Read the three statements again. Who says "I"?
raetsel.hilfe2: Dr Cole is at the Academy. Sam is at the café. Mr Hale is at home.

raetsel.frage: Who says something different from Mr Hale?
raetsel.hilfe1: Mr Hale says: I never came back to the Academy.
raetsel.hilfe2: Who saw Mr Hale at the Academy?

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Mr Hale says he stayed at the Academy on Monday evening.”
raetsel.hilfe2: He says: I went home at six.
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: Mr Hale tells his story. Choose the right words.
raetsel.text: On Monday I ___ home at six. Then I ___ dinner and ___ TV.
raetsel.hilfe1: Mr Hale tells about Monday. Monday is over.
